description: Inspect gene symbols, gene-specific source results, CPIC levels, ClinPGx testing labels, recommendation classifications and input formats. phenotypes requires geneSymbol and preserves distinct activity-score rows, frequencies and consultation text. Live genes/phenotypes support paging; static topics return their complete vocabulary without upstream requests. Use returned values in subsequent discovery, diplotype and recommendation calls.

geneSymbol.description: Exact gene symbol; required for phenotypes, optional for genes, omit for static topics.

limit.description: Positive safe-integer row limit; values above 100 are clamped to 100 with a notice (default 25).

offset.description: Zero-based offset; use nextOffset to continue (default 0).

topic.description: genes lists source gene records; phenotypes requires geneSymbol and lists full gene-result rows; other topics return verified static vocabulary.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_selector`: phenotypes lacks a gene or a static topic receives a gene selector. `query_too_broad`: The workflow work budget is exceeded. `upstream_query_rejected`: CPIC rejects the generated query. `upstream_rate_limited`: CPIC returns HTTP 429. `upstream_unavailable`: CPIC is unavailable or returns a maintenance page. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
